page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 24 vCPUs mapped to 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 186 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU. It includes 1343 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across four local drives, offering high-speed local scratch space without any bundled GPUs.

Performance benchmarks highlight top-tier single-core capabilities. The server achieves top-10% performance in Geekbench single-core testing with a score of 2321.0 and single-threaded compression tasks, such as gzip compression at 36.68 GB/sec. Multi-core performance is strong, ranking in the top 25% with a Geekbench multi-core score of 16159.0. Memory bandwidth is robust, reaching 2024.01 GB/sec for small-block cached reads and 153.52 GB/sec for large-block uncached reads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4-highmem-24-lssd delivers a balanced trade-off between high memory capacity and fast local NVMe storage. The inclusion of dedicated Intel Xeon cores with advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions) enhances its value for specialized vector and matrix operations. This hardware profile is highly suited for memory-intensive databases, caching layers like Redis, data processing pipelines, and workloads requiring rapid local storage I/O.
